payment_rules: A student may choose any one of the three payment plans (Once, Twice, or Three Times) at the point of registration. The plan chosen should be stated clearly on the registration form.
Whichever plan is chosen, the first instalment must be paid before a student's admission is confirmed and before classes begin.

Later instalments must be paid before the due milestone stated above — not after. A student who has not paid the next instalment by its due date may be paused from further sessions until payment is made, but does not lose any progress already completed.
Fees, once paid, are non-refundable, except where the College is unable to deliver the programme through no fault of the student.

These fees cover tuition and core instructional delivery only. They do not cover: transport or accommodation for Mandatory Physical Intensives (Pathway 2), personal materials beyond what OCoYoM provides, or any optional specialisation added after enrolment. This should be stated clearly to every applicant before registration, so there is no confusion later.
